gates.purpose: Freeze a safe battery keepout and thickness budget.
required_evidence: supplier maximum body dimensions including protection board and adhesive
lead exit direction and bend radius
allowed charge/discharge current and NTC requirement
gates.next_action: Measure the received pack or obtain a supplier drawing; update EDA and CAD together.

gates.purpose: Make the PCB outline, USB edge cutout, anchor pads and enclosure opening agree.
gates.current_assumption: E14 still carries the historical board edge and USB candidate geometry.
required_evidence: final J1 drawing and insertion direction
edge slot, anchor and copper clearance accepted by the fabricator
84 x 52 mm outline with tool radius and assembly datum
gates.next_action: Lock J1 mechanical reference, then edit the outline and enclosure datum in one controlled E14 revision.

gates.purpose: Route USB data, VBUS, charger SYS/BAT, 3V3, ground return and EPD signals from the verified netlist.
gates.current_snapshot: Zero copper lines and zero vias; 188 connectivity DRC results are expected.
required_evidence: schematic-to-PCB association rechecked after the final footprint choices
charger, battery and regulator return paths
EPD busy/reset/data lines and local decoupling
gates.next_action: Route critical power and USB nets first, save, reopen and rerun DRC after each block.

gates.purpose: Replace the rectangular NFC reserve with an actual antenna and matching layout.
gates.current_assumption: Upper-right prohibited region is a spatial constraint only.
gates.next_action: Keep the region reserved during routing; do not claim NFC performance until the antenna is measured in the enclosure.

gates.purpose: Turn the spatial study into a manufacturable shell only after the PCB datums are stable.
gates.current_assumption: Current FCStd/STEP is a block-level envelope, not a printable shell.
required_evidence: verified board outline and USB opening
screen window, FPC bend and support
button travel, wall thickness, catches and print clearances
measured battery thickness and strain relief
gates.next_action: Keep the E14 CAD study as a reference and start the shell revision after the outline/USB gate passes.

gates.purpose: Release only a coherent Gerber/Excellon, BOM/CPL and production CAD package.
gates.release_rule: All preceding gates pass, DRC/DFM is reviewed, and the package is saved and reopened from the same E14 revision.
gates.current_snapshot: No Gerber, Excellon, final BOM/CPL, production STEP or printable STL is generated.
gates.next_action: Do not export or send a vendor package from the current snapshot.

ordered_next_actions: Obtain or measure the actual battery envelope and lead/NTC details.
Freeze J1 insertion datum and revise the E14 board outline plus USB opening.
Recheck schematic/PCB associations, then route power and USB critical nets.
Route EPD and control signals, add ground return and validate DRC after save/reopen.
Design NFC antenna and matching after the metal and enclosure boundaries are known.
Convert the CAD envelope into the printable shell and run geometry/visual checks.
Generate the vendor package only after the release gates are green.
